verdict.rationale: Supabase's Postgres RLS is a core, heavily documented feature with concrete policy syntax examples (e.g., restricting SELECT to auth.uid()=user_id) and is also applied to Storage access control. Community feedback corroborates real-world use, noting a learning curve but strong payoff once understood, and it was highlighted as a key differentiator from other BaaS platforms. Missing for 10: independent security audit of RLS enforcement and broader documented examples covering INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE policies beyond the single SELECT example.
